text.title: Competitive Intelligence Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply the Competitive Intelligence methodology end-to-end. Each step lists input, action, output, and an optional decision gate. Folds in the former agentic-pipeline and tools files: Six-subagent pipeline separating mechanical collection from strategic synthesis, with fact-checker and prompt patterns. CLI tools, agent-friendly services, limitations, and operational best practices for a production CI pipeline. Prompt patterns are in `content/05-examples.xml`; limitations and gotchas in `content/03-failure-modes.xml`.

step.name: watchlist-init
step.action: Compile watchlist.yaml; classify each URL by signal type + cadence.

step.name: collect
step.action: Haiku polls URLs, emits one event per delta into NDJSON.

step.name: classify
step.action: Haiku/Sonnet tags events as pricing|feature|hire|funding|review|content; discards noise.

step.name: synthesize-weekly
step.action: Sonnet clusters per competitor; writes weekly digest with event_id citations.

step.name: threat-assess
step.action: Opus scores threats 1-5; refuses with <3 cited events per claim.

step.name: battlecard-regenerate
step.action: Sonnet regenerates per-competitor battlecard; stamps TTL 14d.
step.decision-gate: Refuse to publish if TTL>14d or fact-checker fails.

step.name: fact-check
step.action: Sonnet HEAD-requests every cited URL; rejects 4xx/5xx; flags unsourced claims.
step.decision-gate: If fail, return to upstream step; do not distribute.

list.item: ci-collector (Haiku): Polls YAML watchlist (URLs, keywords, RSS, review sites). Emits normalized JSON events. No reasoning, no synthesis.
ci-classifier (Haiku/Sonnet): Tags each event as pricing | feature | hire | funding | review | content. Discards noise.
ci-synthesizer (Sonnet): Clusters week-of events per competitor, drafts digest with cited sources.
ci-threat-analyst (Opus): Generates threat assessment, "so what" recommendations, scenario planning. Run weekly or on funding/M&A signals.
ci-battlecard-writer (Sonnet): Regenerates per-competitor battlecards from latest digest + win/loss notes. Output to Salesforce, Highspot, or Slack.
ci-fact-checker (Sonnet): Adversarial pass — every claim must cite a fetched URL with a date. Flags unsupported claims before distribution.
firecrawl / jina reader: LLM-ready page extraction with JS rendering — primary fallback for SPA pages
playwright: Custom JS-rendered scrape when API and jina both fail
rss-parser (npm) / feedparser (py): Newsroom + blog ingestion — use RSS before scraping
visualping: Diff alerts on rendered pages — cheap raw signal, no synthesis
phantombuster: LinkedIn hiring/post extraction — use with proxy rotation and respect ToS
apify actors: Headless scrape for G2, LinkedIn, Product Hunt — pay-per-run
crunchbase API: Funding/M&A/leadership — ground truth for firmographic data
ahrefs / semrush API: SEO/SEM moves, top pages, keyword shifts
g2 Buyer Intent API: Review velocity and intent signals

text.reference: Minimal collector loop with Jina reader and NDJSON event store.
